name: Matrix
tagline: Open protocol and Client-Server API for decentralized real-time messaging
description: Matrix is an open standard for decentralized, real-time communication. Developers use the Client-Server API (typically against a homeserver such as matrix.org) to send and receive messages, manage rooms, and build chat clients, bots, and bridges without a single central provider.

auth.details: Access token via Authorization: Bearer header after login or registration (POST /login, /register); optional device_id. No global API key — auth is per homeserver user account.

pricing.free_tier_limits: matrix.org public homeserver is free for accounts; no published per-request free-tier quota for the open Client-Server API
pricing.paid_plans: Homeserver hosting and commercial Matrix services (e.g. Element Matrix Services) are separately priced; the protocol/API itself is free/open

rate_limits: not published globally; homeserver-dependent (matrix.org and other hosts apply their own limits)
use_cases: send a message to a Matrix room
list joined rooms for a user
sync new messages and events for a client
create a room and invite users
look up a user profile or avatar
register a bot account on a homeserver
